decisions.reason: The aloe vera line has several models and its own web page, so it is the firm's most visible and heavily invested recent launch and central to its natural-care positioning; management will persist with it and treat any softness as temporary.

The cleansing oil launched only in 2024 and has had little time to prove itself, and after dropping the cleansing milk the firm needs a cleanser in its facial range, so management will give it more time despite its low visibility and modest investment.
